description: §61.7 — an empty `path=""` does not begin with `/`: E-ENDPOINT-PATH-INVALID (the bootstrap compiled it, mounted at the empty string, until the S480 #2007 review).
rationale: §61.7: "A `path=` SHALL be an absolute path: it begins with `/` … A `path=` outside this grammar is `E-ENDPOINT-PATH-INVALID` (§61.9), reported at the `<endpoint>` opener."
